description: ILS uses the native 0.5-degree land grid g285, comprising shared MATSIRO/CaMa-Flood unit catchments and additional MATSIRO-only non-river cells. Land and catchment states are cell-based; CaMa-Flood discharge and channel velocity refer to downstream river connections and are indexed by the upstream cell. No Arakawa A-E classification is assigned. For data submission, MATSIRO fields are remapped to the regular 0.5-degree latitude-longitude grid g131, while CaMa-Flood fields submitted as unit-catchment values retain their native geometry.
